description: List static lists, optionally filtered by names.
embedding_description: List the Marketo static lists (manually-curated lead segments) configured in this instance, optionally filtered by exact list name — use this to discover a list's id before calling add_leads_to_list or remove_leads_from_list. Distinct from list_campaigns (marketing automation flows) and get_leads (individual lead records).

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with records (a list of list dicts: id, name, description, workspaceName, ...) + row_count + spilled=false inline, OR result_blob_key + row_count + spilled=true when large, plus next_page_token and more_result for continuing the listing.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Summarize the row_count and list names + ids.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: List static lists from the configured Marketo instance.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: marketo.auth_failed: OAuth credentials rejected. marketo.permission_denied: the API user's Role lacks the Access API permission this needs (unconfirmed exact checkbox — see check_setup's guidance). marketo.rate_limited: API rate limit exceeded.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: marketo.rate_limited: retry after a short delay. marketo.auth_failed: ask the operator to check the OAuth client_id/client_secret. marketo.permission_denied: run check_setup — its guidance for this probe points at the Access API tree generally since the exact permission name for list enumeration isn't publicly pinned.
